remarks: Walk to Tilley Pond Park, the Darien Train Station and all the shops and restaurants in Downtown Darien and the Corbin District from this beautiful in-town home on a quiet cul de sac. Built in 2010, this 5 bedroom 4.5 bath colonial provides a wonderful opportunity for anyone making the move to Darien CT - well known for its highly ranked schools, beautiful beaches and convenient commute to NYC. The extremely well appointed kitchen with Sub Zero Fridge, Thermador double ovens and quartz counters is adjacent to the famliy room with wood burning fireplace, French doors leading to the patio with firepit and large informal dining area. An elegant living room with built-ins and gas fireplace and large dining room make entertaining a pleasure. A first floor bedroom and full bath is perfect for guests or could double as a private office. Spacious Primary Suite with two walk-in closets and bath with double vanities and soaking tub as well as four additional good sized bedrooms with baths are all on the second floor. A bonus room off the mudroom is a perfect playroom or movie room. The private yard and the front porch are both excellent options for morning coffee or evening cocktails. Other features include attached two car garage, invisible dog fence and generator.
